data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** 6da78d8d4e0f138d53cd5527da7de4a21198e672
* **script:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior
In a local session, merge-to-main-pr.sh should automatically delegate PR finalize to PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md (driven by the session agent) without requiring an external $_LLM_DISPATCH_CMD shim. The CLAUDE.md guidance is that the session agent IS the LLM dispatch.

#### Actual Behavior
Session of 2026-05-12. After PR #98 was created, merge-to-main-pr.sh emitted:

```
ESCALATE: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set; no LLM helper available (deleted in S3). For LOCAL sessions: read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/workflows/PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md and drive the loop via the session agent + pr-finalize-classify.sh. For CI: configure _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to a compat-shim. Refusing to silently skip. UNRESOLVED: PR:https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/98
```

The script could auto-detect 'local interactive session' (e.g., presence of CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or absence of CI=true) and call pr-finalize-classify.sh in-loop instead of escalating. The PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md doc literally describes how to drive this — the script could do it directly when the session agent is implied.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Script: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
* Workflow: PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md
* Caller: /dso:end-session Step 11
* Related: f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d Story 8c9c-36ea (deleted _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD in S3)
* Fix sketch: emit ESCALATE only when both CI and local-interactive context are absent. In local interactive sessions, write a one-line directive 'AGENT_LOOP:pr-finalize PR:<url>' and exit 0 so the orchestrator picks up PR-FINALIZE-WORKFLOW.md transparently.
data.title: [merge-to-main-pr.sh]: local session -> ESCALATE: _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD not set (deleted in S3) instead of using session agent
